heroDescription: TABVAR has supported Bow Valley route developers and retrofitters since 1994. Here you will find our funding caps, claim spreadsheets, bulk hardware order schedules, and 316 stainless steel standards.

seasonalBanner.bulkDeadlineText: Bulk hardware orders are processed annually in winter. Deadline for orders is 16:00 MST on Tuesday, January 20. Delivery arrives for spring cragging.
seasonalBanner.claimsDeadlineText: New route and retrofit reimbursement claims for this season are due by August 1. Ensure your claim includes topos and approach beta.

fundingCaps.description: Annual funding cap for new routes developed using 316 stainless steel mechanical expansion bolts.
Higher subsidy cap to encourage long-lasting glue-in bolts and structural epoxy installations.
No annual dollar limit on legitimate retrofits replacing aging, dangerous, or plated hardware on established routes.

actionCardDescription: Active route developers volunteer hundreds of hours cleaning loose limestone, establishing classic lines, and installing certified hardware. TABVAR covers 100% of qualified hardware costs so climbers can enjoy safe, enduring routes.

claimSteps.title: Read the Guidelines
claimSteps.description: Ensure your hardware meets the 100% 316 stainless steel requirement.

claimSteps.title: Copy the Spreadsheet
claimSteps.description: Make a copy of the official New Route Claim Form or Retrofit Claim Form in Google Sheets.

claimSteps.title: Name Your File
claimSteps.description: Include your full name in the spreadsheet file title.

claimSteps.title: Attach Topos & Approach Info
claimSteps.description: For all new routes, put together a detailed route description and topo with approach directions. This is mandatory for claim processing.

claimSteps.title: Submit via Email
claimSteps.description: Email your completed spreadsheet and topo to claims@tabvar.org. Confirmations are typically sent within two weeks.

bulkOrderDescription: TABVAR pools community orders directly with certified manufacturers, ensuring local route builders get top-tier 316 marine-grade hardware at unbeatable bulk rates before spring cragging begins.
